info.name: ClimateShield Backend API (Government Command Center)
info.description: ClimateShield REST API. DEMO DATA NOTICE: every seeded coordinate/measurement/event is SYNTHETIC_DEMO. HOW TO USE: 1) Set 'baseUrl' (default http://localhost:4000). 2) Run 'Login (government operator)' FIRST - it auto-saves the JWT to {{token}}; every other request uses it automatically. 3) 'Dispatch' auto-saves the created task code to {{taskCode}}; 'Create task', 'List simulations' and 'List hotspots' auto-save ids too. Full contracts: cline_backend/docs/API.md

request.description: Public, rate-limited (20 per 15 min). Auto-saves JWT to {{token}}. Demo accounts (password in collection variables): government@ / dispatcher@ / admin@ / field@ / analyst@climateshield.demo
Returns the SafeUser for the token (never passwordHash).
Returns { status: ok, database: connected, timestamp }. 503 when PostgreSQL is down.

Overview dashboard: resilienceIndex/Level + trend, activeThreats, monitoredZones, criticalInfrastructure{total,compromised,degraded}, mobility{index,status,blockedRoads}, grid{status,loadPercent}, precipitation, heat, activeIncidents, criticalIncidents, resourceReadiness, recentCriticalIncidents[], activeHazards[]. All computed from PostgreSQL (dataQuality: SYNTHETIC_DEMO).
Query: page, limit, severity, status, type, zoneId, hazardId, search. Example: /api/incidents?severity=CRITICAL&status=NEW&page=1&limit=20

Accepts id or incidentCode. Returns incident (severity, zone, hazard, primaryAsset, SLA + slaMinutesRemaining, assignedUnits) + cascade{rootAsset, baseRisk, nodes[]} + availableUnits[]. Everything the detail drawer and Assign Team button need.
Computed dependency-cascade: DRAIN-07 -> RD-24 -> GATE-B -> HOSP-01 with impactType + impactScore per depth.

request.description: GOV roles (GOVERNMENT_OPERATOR/DISPATCHER/ADMIN). Backend assigns INC-### code, status NEW, SLA from severity (CRITICAL 2h / HIGH 4h / MODERATE 8h / LOW 24h), computes + persists cascade.
GOV. Optional fields: title, description, severity, hazardId (nullable), primaryAssetId (nullable).
GOV. Valid transitions: NEW->ACKNOWLEDGED|IN_PROGRESS, ACKNOWLEDGED->IN_PROGRESS|RESOLVED, IN_PROGRESS->RESOLVED, RESOLVED->CLOSED. Invalid -> 422 INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION.

GOV roles only. Fully transactional: creates TASK-### (priority from incident severity), assigns unit, TaskStatusHistory + AuditLog, auto-acknowledges a NEW incident. Auto-saves the new task code to {{taskCode}}. Errors: 422 INCIDENT_NOT_ACTIVE, 409 DUPLICATE_DISPATCH (same unit+incident), 409 UNIT_NOT_AVAILABLE, 404s.

Dispatch board: summary{activeIncidents, critical/high/moderate, unassignedIncidents, assignedUnits, readinessPercent, avgResponseMinutes, slaCompliancePercent, targetResolutionHours}, severityGroups{CRITICAL,HIGH,MODERATE,LOW}, activeIncidents[], unassignedIncidents[], availableUnits[], telemetry summary, hotspots[].

GOV roles. No body needed. Deterministic PROPOSED-only plan (status: PROPOSED, nothing auto-executed): riskScore, priority, etaMinutes, affectedAssets, recommendedActions[], recommendedUnits[], cascadeSummary[]. Accepts zone id or code.
Query: page, limit, status, priority, incidentId, assignedUnitId, assetId, assignedDepartmentId. Example: /api/tasks?status=ASSIGNED
Accepts id or taskCode (TASK-001 seeded; {{taskCode}} is auto-set by Dispatch / Create task).

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Postman demo task: inspect drainage grate",
  "description": "Synthetic demo task created from Postman.",
  "assetId": "DRAIN-07",
  "assignedDepartmentId": "PW",
  "priority": "MEDIUM"
}

request.description: GOV. incidentId (must be active), assetId, assignedUnitId (must be AVAILABLE -> becomes ASSIGNED), assignedDepartmentId, priority, slaDeadline all optional. Auto-saves new taskCode to {{taskCode}}.

FIELD_OPERATOR / DISPATCHER / GOV. Edit the status field between sends and run the full chain: ASSIGNED -> ACKNOWLEDGED -> IN_PROGRESS -> COMPLETED (any status -> CANCELLED). COMPLETED/CANCELLED release the unit back to AVAILABLE. Invalid skips -> 422 INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION. Tip: run Dispatch first, then this request 3x with each status.
GOV. Only for tasks WITHOUT a unit (409 TASK_ALREADY_ASSIGNED otherwise), unit must be AVAILABLE (409 UNIT_NOT_AVAILABLE).
GOV. Only COMPLETED tasks (422 TASK_NOT_COMPLETED), only once (409 TASK_ALREADY_VERIFIED). Sets verifiedAt + TASK_VERIFIED audit.
Full transition chain with actor names/roles.
Query: status, type, departmentId, search, page, limit. Example: /api/units?status=AVAILABLE
Accepts id or callsign (e.g. PW-DRAIN-A1).
Unit state machine: AVAILABLE<->ASSIGNED/EN_ROUTE/ON_SCENE/BUSY/OFFLINE. Example flips the OFFLINE maintenance unit back to AVAILABLE. Invalid -> 422.

Query: facilityType, zoneId, vulnerability (min 0-100), status, criticality, search, page, limit. Examples: ?facilityType=HOSPITAL | ?vulnerability=80 | ?search=Substation | ?status=COMPROMISED. Each item includes criticality, vulnerability, operationalStatus, failoverPower, backupPower, waterProximityM, evacuationStatus, beds, bedOccupancyPercent, telemetry{}, telemetryDelayMinutes, risk{score,level}, activeIncidents, activeTasks.
Accepts id or assetCode. Returns asset + zone + telemetry + risk + hazard + cascade + upstream/downstream dependencies + active tasks/incidents.
Query: metric (rainfall, water_depth, temperature, thermal_load, pump_runtime, power_load, occupancy, water_reserve, wind_speed), limit.
Deterministic risk: score, level, confidence, factors[{name, contribution}], explanation, components. Persists a snapshot.
upstream[] (what this asset depends on) + downstream[] (what depends on this asset) + cascadePreview[].
Audit logs + tasks (with status history) + incidents + telemetry + risk snapshots for the facility.

GOV. Without unitId the backend auto-picks the best AVAILABLE unit by asset type (DRAIN/PUMPING -> PUMP_CREW, SUBSTATION -> UTILITY, HOSPITAL -> EMS...). Optional: { "unitId": "unit_pump_2" }. Transactional + audited. 409 NO_UNITS_AVAILABLE if none free.
GOV. Creates a PUBLIC_WORKS maintenance task (unassigned - dispatch a unit later via /api/tasks/:id/assign).
GOV. Audited advisory with alternative routes (operational roads/bridges in the same zone).
Query: riskLevel, page, limit. Zone summaries with asset/hotspot counts, active hazards and active incident counts.
Accepts id or code (zone_eb / EB). Zone + assets + activeHazards + activeIncidents + hotspots.

riskScore/riskLevel, riskFactors, contributingFactors, impact{blockedRoads, affectedFacilities, residents}, cascade vector (asset -> impact), impactedInfrastructure, affectedRoads, affectedFacilities, recommendedResponseActions[].
Query: type, severity, status, zoneId, activeOnly, page, limit. Example: /api/hazards?activeOnly=true
Hazard + zone + linked incidents + recent risk scores.
GOV. Types: FLOOD, FLASH_FLOOD, EXTREME_HEAT, STORM, HIGH_WIND, DRAINAGE_OVERFLOW, POWER_FAILURE, OTHER. Optional: flowVelocity, temperature, windSpeed, durationMinutes, startedAt.
GeoJSON FeatureCollection (MapLibre-ready). Query: zoneId, assetType, status, criticality.
Query: zoneId, severity, hazardType, status.
Query: zoneId, severity, status (default: active incidents only).
Query: status, type, departmentId (default: non-OFFLINE units).
One call for all layer toggles: floodZones, heatZones, roadClosures, criticalInfrastructure, drainageTelemetry, evacuationCorridors, incidents, units - each a FeatureCollection.

GOV + ANALYST. Deterministic: derives severity from parameters (rainfall x drainage throughput + tidal surge; heat/wind thresholds), runs the real risk engine per asset, persists Simulation + per-zone SimulationResult. Returns results[] {riskScore, affectedAssets, affectedRoads, estimatedPopulation, estimatedDamage{totalUsd...}, recommendedActions[]} + summary. Optional: name, zoneId (single-zone run).
Query: scenarioType, status, page, limit. Auto-saves the newest simulation id to {{simulationId}} - run this before 'Simulation detail'.
Single simulation with all per-zone results + summary. Run 'List simulations' first.

incidentTrends (14 daily buckets), responsePerformance{avgResponseMinutes, avgCompletionMinutes, slaCompliancePercent}, incidentsBySeverity, infrastructureFailures, hazardFrequency, hotspotRecurrence, departmentPerformance, resourceUtilization.
Query: hazardType, zoneId, severity (LOW/MODERATE/HIGH/CRITICAL floors), minRecurrence (0-1). Ordered by recurrenceScore desc. Auto-saves first id to {{hotspotId}}.
Hotspot + zone + 10 most recent related SYNTHETIC_DEMO historical events. Run 'List hotspots' first.
Query: type, page, limit. Includes unitCount + activeTaskCount per department.
Accepts id or code (PW / EMS / FR / PD / UTL / WTR / EM). Includes users (no passwordHash) + counts.
Query: status, page, limit.

fleet{totalUnits, available, deployed, busy, offline, utilizationPercent, readinessPercent}, workload{activeTasks, completedTasks30d, avgCompletionMinutes, slaCompliancePercent}, posture (READY / HIGH_DEMAND / SATURATED).
ADMIN + GOVERNMENT_OPERATOR only (403 otherwise). Query: action, entityType, entityId, userId, page, limit. Example: /api/audit?entityType=TASK&limit=50
